facts.fact: NITDA's director-general linked the localisation drive to President Tinubu's executive order designating digital infrastructure as Critical National Information Infrastructure, BusinessDay reports.

facts.fact: BusinessDay reports the Central Bank of Nigeria issued a circular requiring payment data to be localised in Nigeria by 1 January 2027.
The CBN's payments system supervision department director said the CBN supervises compliance with the payment data localisation requirement, with sanctions reserved for deliberate non-compliance.

NITDA's director-general said NITDA's National Sovereign Cloud Initiative framework anchors Nigeria's data localisation policy and that a deadline will be set for ministries, departments and agencies after the financial sector's 1 January 2027 deadline.
